file(GLOB winmine_rc_deps rc/*.*)
add_rc_deps(rsrc.rc ${winmine_rc_deps})

# winmine.exe is all Rust (winmine-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/winmine-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winmine-rust/src/winmine/main.rs)
# dialog.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/winmine-rust/src/winmine/dialog.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(winmine_res OBJECT rsrc.rc)
target_compile_definitions(winmine_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(winmine_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(WINMINE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/libwine/libwine.a)
add_cargo_module(winmine winmine-cargo winmine.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE winmine-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS winmine_res ${WINMINE_REUSED})
